title: FounderGate Checker Queue
description: Declares a BOUNDED checker swarm: a fixed set of checker tasks, a hard fanout cap, and a hard loop cap. The coordinator that consumes this document may NEVER spawn an uncontrolled swarm — it dispatches at most max_fanout checkers per loop and runs at most max_loops (<=2) loops. This is a spec/schema surface only: it describes the shape of a swarm request. It does not spawn a process, open a socket, or contact any host. default_disposition is always 'hold' — nothing auto-passes; a deduped verdict is a report, not an authorization.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this queue schema the emitter targeted.

queue_id.description: Stable identifier of this swarm request.

max_fanout.description: Hard cap on how many checkers the coordinator may dispatch in a SINGLE loop. Must be >=1 and <=16. Total work is bounded by max_fanout * max_loops — there is no uncontrolled fanout.

max_loops.description: Hard cap on coordinator loops. The coordinator forbids more than 2 loops (no runaway re-check). Must be 1 or 2.

default_disposition.description: Fail-closed default. Must be 'hold' — no checker outcome auto-authorizes anything; the aggregate is a report for a human/sheriff.

describes_only.description: Honesty invariant. This queue DESCRIBES a swarm request; it never enforces. Must be true.

enforced.description: Honesty invariant. This spec is NOT a live enforcement surface. Must be false.

checkers.description: The checker tasks in this swarm. Each names a (target, dimension) and the fixture report it will consume. Bounded: at most 64 tasks may be declared, and the coordinator will still only dispatch max_fanout*max_loops of them.

checker_id.description: Unique-within-queue id of this checker task. Uniqueness is additionally enforced by the coordinator.

target.description: What this checker inspects. Reports are deduped by (target, dimension).

report_ref.description: Reference (basename) of the fixture checker-report this task consumes. Offline only — resolved against the fixtures/reports directory by the test harness.
